required_review_questions: Does the append-only store preserve hash-chain, duplicate-event rejection, revision/DAG CAS, single-writer and crash/replay fail-closed semantics?
Are prepared-result retries idempotent and are invalid delivery transitions, including completion before ACK, rejected?
Does the foreground driver prevent blind retry, keep UNKNOWN_DELIVERY reconciliation-only, distinguish ACK from completion and re-check STOP/generation before the fake effect?
Can any real provider, Team Router runtime, endpoint, app, DB or network capability be reached from the implementation?
Does the Windows ACL checker prove owner/DACL facts while correctly failing when no actual other non-admin token is available?
Are any implementation defects present independently of the known ACL_NEGATIVE_UNVERIFIED environmental blocker?

known_blocker.meaning: No actual other non-admin Windows token was supplied for the same protected fixture.
